description_en: E-commerce Video Remix is an AI video service designed for product content production. It covers video understanding, element replacement, quality verification, and result delivery. The service focuses on product and person consistency, detail restoration, conversion-oriented expression, and large-scale production. It supports targeted replacement of products or persons based on hit video templates while preserving the original actions, shot rhythm, and marketing structure to rapidly generate multi-version content and reduce shooting, editing, and adaptation costs
description_zh: 电商视频裂变是一套面向商品内容生产的 AI 视频服务，覆盖视频理解、元素替换、质量校验和结果交付。产品聚焦商品与人物一致性、细节还原、转化表达和规模化生产，支持基于爆款视频母版定向替换商品或人物，在保留原有动作、镜头节奏和营销结构的基础上，快速生成多版本内容，降低拍摄、剪辑和适配成本
name: EcomVideoRecreation

fields.example: The target character is an adult male, with the original costume and movements preserved.
fields.help_en:
The description or supplementary constraints for the target person in person replacement mode. 1 to 500 characters. Required when PersonReferenceImageUrls is not provided.   
Example: The target person is an adult male. Retain the original clothing and actions
fields.help_zh:
人物替换目标人物描述或补充约束，1～500 字符。未提供 PersonReferenceImageUrls 时必填   
示例值：目标人物为一名成年男性，保留原片服装和动作
fields.name: change_description

fields.help_en: The replacement mode. Valid values: `product_replacement` (default) and `person_replacement`
fields.name: mode

fields.help_en:
The URLs of target person reference images for person replacement. 1 to 5 images of the same person are supported. Arrange images in the following order: face close-up, front view, 45-degree angle, side view, and back view.  
Example: ["https://example.com/person.jpg"]
fields.help_zh:
人物替换时的目标人物参考图 URL，1～5 张，须为同一人物。建议按面部特写、正面、45°、侧面、背面顺序排列  
示例值：["https://example.com/person.jpg"]
fields.name: person_reference_image_urls

fields.help_en:
The URL of the target product image. Required for product replacement. Exactly one image must be provided. A clear subject with no occlusion and a clean background is recommended.  
Example: ["https://example.com/product.png"]
fields.help_zh:
商品替换时必填，目标商品图 URL，必须且只能提供 1 张。建议主体清晰、无遮挡、背景干净  
示例值：["https://example.com/product.png"]
fields.name: product_image_urls

fields.help_en:
The product category.  
Example: Women's Clothing/Sun Protection Jacket
fields.help_zh:
商品类目  
示例值：女装/防晒衣
fields.name: category

fields.example: Light moon yellow, cool-touch fabric, sun protection extending to the back of the hand, UPF50+
fields.help_en:
The actual product information (SKU, brand, color, material, size, specifications, logo, and usage), used to constrain voiceover facts.  
Example: Light moon yellow, cool-touch fabric, sun protection to the back of the hand, UPF50+
fields.help_zh:
商品真实信息（SKU、品牌、颜色、材质、尺寸、规格、Logo 和使用方式等），用于约束口播事实  
示例值：淡月黄色，凉感面料，防晒至手背，UPF50+
fields.name: detail

fields.example: Light moon yellow cool-touch sun protection clothing
fields.help_en:
Required for product replacement. The name of the target product. Maximum length: 200 characters.  
Example: Light Moon Yellow Cool-touch Sun Protection Jacket
fields.help_zh:
商品替换时必填，需提供目标替换的商品名称，最多 200 字符  
示例值：淡月黄凉感防晒衣
fields.name: title

fields.help_en: The target product information. Provide this parameter to improve voiceover accuracy
fields.help_zh: 目标商品信息，建议填写以提升口播准确度
fields.name: product_info

fields.help_en: The HTTP(S) URL of the reference video. The video duration must be in the range of 2 to 360 seconds. The URL must remain accessible during task execution. Set the URL validity period to at least 24 hours
fields.help_zh: 参考视频 HTTP(S) URL，时长范围 2～360 秒。须在任务执行期间保持可访问，建议有效期不少于 24 小时
fields.name: source_video_url

parameters.help_en: The input parameters for video remix
parameters.name: input

fields.help_en: The target duration in seconds. `"auto"` (default): determined by the system. For product replacement, an integer from 5 to 60 can be specified. For person replacement, only `"auto"` is supported
fields.help_zh: 目标时长（秒）。``"auto"``（默认）由系统决定；商品替换可传 5～60 整数秒；人物替换仅支持 `"auto"`
fields.name: duration

fields.help_en: The output aspect ratio. Default value: `auto` (automatically matches the original video)
fields.help_zh: 输出画幅，默认`auto`（自动匹配原片）
fields.name: ratio

parameters.help_en: The output specifications for the final video
parameters.name: output

Code.description_en: The result code. `success` indicates success. An error code is returned upon failure
Code.description_zh: 结果码。`success`成功，失败时返回对应错误码

TaskId.description_en: The asynchronous task ID for QueryAsyncTaskResult queries
TaskId.description_zh: 用于 QueryAsyncTaskResult 查询的异步任务 ID
TaskId.title_en: 用于 QueryAsyncTaskResult 查询的异步任务 ID
TaskId.title_zh: 用于 QueryAsyncTaskResult 查询的异步任务 ID

Message.description_en: The response message. An error description is returned upon failure
Message.description_zh: 返回信息，失败时返回错误说明

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, used to identify a unique call
RequestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，用于识别唯一一次调用

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the submission is successful
